settings.title: Anja Meeting Pod: Your Space for Focus

settings.text:
In today's bustling work environment, distractions are constant. Noise and interruptions can derail focus and productivity, hindering your performance and creativity. That's where our soundproof meeting booth comes in.

A Tranquil Retreat

At Soundbox Store, we understand the value of a quiet and comfortable workspace. The Anja Meeting Pod offers a tranquil and ergonomic cocoon where up to two people can focus with minimal interruption, delivering outstanding results.

Premium Soundproofing

Our meeting pods are built to the highest standards, providing excellent sound insulation and noise reduction of up to 30 dB. The acoustic panels are crafted from recycled PET, ensuring superior sound absorption and preventing noise leaks.

Comfort and Ergonomics

The Anja Meeting Pod prioritises your comfort with adjustable lighting and integrated ventilation, creating a stress-free environment for extended work sessions.

Swift Setup

At Soundbox Store, we understand that time is valuable. The Anja Meeting Pod arrives ready for plug-and-play installation with easy-to-follow instructions.

Your Productivity Oasis

The Anja soundproof meeting pod is the ideal solution for a quiet and comfortable two-person workspace. With superior sound insulation, an aluminium frame, tempered glass and easy installation, it's the perfect addition to any busy office environment. Say goodbye to distractions and invest in an acoustic meeting pod today.

With superior sound insulation, a curved wraparound design, and plug-and-play installation, our meeting pods are the perfect addition to any busy office environment. Lights, Power, Action! The Anja Meeting Pod is equipped with adjustable LED lighting and an integrated power supply to run the devices you need. Its curved wraparound design keeps two people comfortable and focused, while plug-and-play installation means it's ready to use in minutes.
The Anja Meeting Pod also has adjustable LED lighting, offering a comfortable, well-illuminated environment.
New interior design ideas? Not a problem! The Anja Pod is free-standing and can be repositioned to suit your space whenever your layout changes.
The integrated ventilation system replaces the air regularly within the Anja Meeting Pod, helping occupants feel fresh and comfortable and promoting health and wellbeing.

We've considered every element of the Anja Meeting Pod from the best in acoustic technology, comfort, flexibility and safety. Every detail is considered, complementing the clients' interior design aspirations, with quick plug-and-play installation!
